read.thesis: Mosaic's 2025 working-capital build (-$960M) and sulfur spike compress 2026 phosphate margins, though management guides $300–500M working-capital release, 7M+ tons phosphate output, and capex rising to ~$1.5B on gyp stacks.

utilisation.quote: we need an operating factor of low 80s, 81% of our overall fertilizer assets in North America

capex.quote: We expect CapEx in 2026 to come in around $1,500,000,000, higher than 2025 due to mine, gyp stack, and clay settling area expansions in Florida.

triggers.label: Working capital release $300–500M
triggers.quote: a $300,000,000 to $500,000,000 working capital release is highly possible

triggers.label: Capex up to ~$1.5B in 2026
triggers.quote: CapEx in 2026 to come in around $1,500,000,000, higher than 2025

triggers.label: Sulfur spike compresses margins into 2026
triggers.quote: significantly compress margins in our Phosphates and Mosaic Fertilizantes segments well into 2026

triggers.label: Q1 2026 EBITDA headwind $250M
triggers.quote: we thus expect a roughly $250,000,000 headwind to Q1 2026 EBITDA

triggers.label: Brazil Araxá and Fospar idled
triggers.quote: We have idled Araxá and Fospar in Brazil, our lowest margin operations, until further notice.

guidance.quote: we expect to produce at least 7,000,000 tons of phosphate in 2026
we expect to produce around 9,000,000 tons of potash this year
We expect CapEx in 2026 to come in around $1,500,000,000
a $300,000,000 to $500,000,000 working capital release is highly possible
positions us to achieve another year of doubling net sales

red_flags.label: Net debt up $829M on working capital build
red_flags.quote: Working capital reduced cash flow by $960,000,000 for the year and contributed to an $829,000,000 increase in net debt.

red_flags.label: Brazil retailer and grower bankruptcies
red_flags.quote: Increased retailer and grower bankruptcy filings are constraining volume outlook and requiring a conservative sales strategy.

evasions.quote: we are not providing full-year 2026 Mosaic Fertilizantes sales volumes guidance

evasions.topic: Phosphate production guidance vs trailing run-rate
evasions.quote: our guide is going to be on actually demonstrated prior trailing three months
